name: Grant Application
description: Build a compliant, scoreable grant application directly from the funding opportunity, work plan, budget, and review rubric.

tasks.name: Parse the funding opportunity
tasks.objective: Extract eligibility, deadline and time zone, mandatory registrations, required forms and attachments, project period, funding range, match or cost-share, allowable costs, scoring criteria, page and format rules, submission channel, and amendment or Q&A history.

tasks.name: Run eligibility and fit gate
tasks.objective: Verify applicant and project eligibility against exact opportunity language. Map organizational evidence to each criterion and stop early on hard disqualifiers instead of writing beautifully into the void.

tasks.name: Build project logic and work plan
tasks.objective: Define need, target population, goal, measurable objectives, activities, outputs, outcomes, assumptions, dependencies, schedule, partners, risks, and monitoring and evaluation plan.

tasks.name: Build budget and narrative together
tasks.objective: Cost the actual work plan, document calculations, quotes, and assumptions, map every cost to allowed categories and project activities, and reconcile narrative totals with required budget forms.

tasks.name: Draft to scoring rubric
tasks.objective: Write the proposal in the funder’s structure and vocabulary; make each scoring criterion easy to locate, supported by evidence, and consistent with work plan, budget, and evaluation.

tasks.name: Run compliance and reviewer simulation
tasks.objective: Check every required attachment and field, format, signature, identifier, match commitment, page limit, budget arithmetic, and deadline. Score the draft against published criteria and identify unsupported claims.

tasks.name: Package and submit
tasks.objective: Create final checklist, filenames, version-controlled submission package, portal confirmation, timestamped receipt, and contingency path for portal failure. Preserve exactly what was submitted.
